meta.question: Is any Strip poker event dated 2026-11-16..2026-12-23 confirmed single-entry / freezeout (no re-entry, no rebuy, no add-on) by an official source?

searches.query: Las Vegas Strip poker tournament single entry freezeout no re-entry December 2026

results_used.what: WPT's own 2025-season WC page: 'One (1) Entry maximum (freezeout per starting flight)'. This is the 2025 season (Dec 2025) and is outside the trip window, so it is NOT used for any 2026 row. Recorded as a wording example only.
WSOP 2026 Main Event is freezeout, but WSOP 2026 runs May 26 to July 15, 2026 at Horseshoe/Paris, outside the window. Not a Strip event in the trip window; not used.

searches.query: Venetian Las Vegas poker room tournament schedule November December 2026 official

results_used.what: Official DSE IV calendar page (Nov 16 to Dec 23, 2026). Matches the stored schedule rows checked.

Live Wynn poker page: WPT World Championship Nov 27 to Dec 21, 2026; Daily Tournaments 'View Schedule' and 'Structures' link to the same CDN assets the repo cites (poker-daily-tournament-poster.pdf and Poker-All_Daily_Structures.pdf). Daily page wording: '$40,000 guaranteed NLH Rebuy on Friday' and '$10,000 guaranteed event every evening at 6 p.m.' Consistent with the captured poster (Mon-Thu $10k at 12 p.m.; nightly $10k at 6 p.m.).

verdict.text: No event in the 2026-11-16 to 2026-12-23 window is confirmed single-entry by an official source. The verdict in the data (0 of 253 rows) stands. Omission remains unverified, not a freezeout.
